skills.name: What Are You Looking At?
skills.desc: Deals Ice DMG equal to #1[i]% of Herta's ATK to one designated enemy.

skills.name: One-Time Offer
skills.desc: Deals Ice DMG equal to #1[i]% of Herta's ATK to all enemies. If the enemy's HP percentage is #2[i]% or higher, DMG dealt to this target increases by #3[i]%.

skills.name: It's Magic, I Added Some Magic
skills.desc: Deals Ice DMG equal to #1[i]% of Herta's ATK to all enemies.

skills.name: Fine, I'll Do It Myself
skills.desc: When an ally target's attack causes an enemy target's HP percentage to fall to #1[i]% or lower, Herta will launch a Follow-Up ATK, dealing Ice DMG equal to #2[i]% of Herta's ATK to all enemies.

skills.name: It Can Still Be Optimized
skills.desc: After using her Technique, Herta's ATK increases by #1[i]% for #2[i] turn(s) at the beginning of the next battle.

passives.name: Efficiency
passives.desc: When Skill is used, the DMG Boost effect on target enemies increases by an extra 25%.

passives.name: Puppet
passives.desc: Increases the chance to resist Crowd Control debuffs by 35%.

passives.name: Icing
passives.desc: When Ultimate is used, deals 20% more DMG to Frozen enemies.
